trailhead.label: Ospizio Bernina station on the Bernina railway, the board’s start

cautions: No shade at 2,200 m: strong sun and wind, bring water.
Weather turns fast on the pass: bring a layer for you and your dog.
The Bernina railway runs along the lake: lead short near the tracks.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
